item.title: Pirate Nation developer Proof of Play shuts down
item.summary: Proof of Play, the US blockchain game developer behind Pirate Nation, announced on 4th August that it is ceasing operations. The company said it had failed to build a product and sustainable business capable of proving its central thesis: that blockchain games could help create a new, decentralized internet.
